title: TikTok Algorithm Update Favors Longer Retention
executive_summary: TikTok quietly updated its algorithm to weight 30-second+ retention higher than completion rate. Creators adapting to longer-form vertical video are seeing 40% reach increases.
key_insight: TikTok is pivoting to YouTube-style retention metrics -- the 15-second hook era is ending.
draft_post:
TikTok just killed the 15-second hook. 

New algorithm weights 30s+ retention over completion rate. Creators making 60-90s vertical videos are seeing 40% reach gains.

The pivot: Hook -> Value -> Deep Value -> CTA

Who's already testing longer verticals?
